release_crm.description: The CRM: contacts, leads, companies, deals, tasks, reports and fields.

release_outreach.description: Sequences (AGL-2974): one-to-one email sequences from a rep's own connected mailbox, logged in the CRM. OFF by default, staff preview only. It also needs the outreach entitlement, which no plan carries, so a customer gets it only by a per-org override.

release_data_store.description: Datasets, models and dynamic data bindings.

release_marketplace.description: Marketplace browsing, publishing and plugin installs.

release_member_accounts.description: Visitor accounts on published sites: /signin, /signup, /recover and the Members blocks (AGL-2486). Platform kill switch; per-site enablement is the User Accounts toggle.

release_commerce_v2.description: Commerce v2 wave: catalog, cart/checkout, digital goods, reservations, POS, repriced tiers (AGL-276..331).

release_marketing.description: Overlays, campaigns at-a-glance, and A/B experiments.

release_email.description: Designed emails, campaigns, and audience sending.

release_inbox.description: Form submissions, site members, and the lead inbox.

release_logic.description: Variables, no-code functions, and reference health.

release_addon_store.description: Self-serve add-on purchases on the Billing page: seats, datasets, extra sites, POS registers, Event Calendar.

release_native_checkout.description: Pay for a plan without leaving the console - Stripe embedded Checkout instead of a redirect. OFF by default until a real card has been through it.

release_edit_bar.description: Site admin bar on published sites (AGL-1302 follow-on). Released 2026-09-16 (AGL-3041), on for every site. Turning it off hides the bar and revokes every outstanding edit token at the verify site.

release_assist.description: Aglyn Assist, the in-console AI chat helper (AGL-1860). OFF by default; needs two published legal artifacts (AGL-1909): the privacy-policy Q&A disclosure and the Anthropic row on /legal/subprocessors. The real trigger is ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, not the flag.

release_video_uploads.description: New video in the media library, on every upload path (AGL-2830). OFF by default: a video is refused with 403 video_uploads_paused. Images, documents and stored videos are unaffected; grant one org through its release-flag override.

release_video_delivery.description: Serves library video from a configured delivery provider through short-lived signed redirects, and copies each video to it (AGL-2824). OFF by default: video serves from this platform as before. Also needs the provider's settings.

release_ai_generative.description: Aglyn AI: generative building and automation behind the AI add-on (AGL-2903). OFF by default, staff preview only; generative routes answer 404 while off. On, it sends customer briefs and site content to Anthropic under the Assist disclosure (AGL-1909).

version.description: Release flags seed (AGL-231): one JSON parameter per release-gated console feature; managed in the staff admin Feature Flags page thereafter. AGL-1635: a value here is the PLATFORM default and is not the last word — an org doc may carry a per-org override at orgs/{orgId}.releaseFlags, set from the staff Override dialog, which wins over both the value below and its rollout percentage. If one organization sees a feature this file says is off, look there before editing anything here.
